200.description:
A scheduled span for a habit (#503).

Its effect depends on `habits.active`:
- `active = true`: the span suppresses task generation (a pause).
- `active = false`: the span enables task generation (an activation window).

`start_date` / `end_date` are inclusive `YYYY-MM-DD` strings in the
user's local timezone.

Abandonability.description:
A value in `[0.0, 1.0]` representing how easily a task can be abandoned.

Higher values mean the task is more likely to be dropped when the schedule
does not fit. `new` silently clamps the input to `[0.0, 1.0]`; `NaN`
becomes `0.5`.

label.description: Label shown in the completion UI.

value.description: Full query value after selecting this completion.

CreateHabitBatchItem.description: A single habit inside a batch create request (#1083).

CreateHabitBatchResult.description: A single result from a batch create request (#1083).

window_mode.description:
Window mode for generated tasks (#window_mode).
`'day'` (default) = occurrence day's start_time..end_time.
`'period'` = occurrence start_time .. next occurrence's start_time.

habit_step_id.description: habit step link (#95). Set by sync_habit_tasks for step-generated tasks.

original_quantity_total.description: WI-9: pre-split total quantity, kept for lineage.

quantity_total.description: WI-9: total quantity for a quantitative task.

CreateTaskBatchItem.description:
A single task inside a batch create request (#1083).
`client_id` is a caller-supplied temporary id that can be referenced by
`depends` of other items in the same batch.

habit_step_id.description: habit step link (#95). Set by sync_habit_tasks for step-generated tasks.

original_quantity_total.description: WI-9: pre-split total quantity, kept for lineage.

quantity_done.description: WI-9: initial quantity already done (defaults to 0).

quantity_total.description: WI-9: total quantity for a quantitative task.

CreateTaskBatchResult.description:
A single result from a batch create request (#1083).
The caller can correlate results with input items by `client_id` and by
position.

actual_minutes.description: Total active work minutes from task_work_sessions (NULL when no work has been done).

completed_at.description: WI-9: wall-clock completion time, set by `complete`.

habit_step_id.description:
The habit step that generated this task, if any (#95). NULL for simple
(step-less) habits and manually created tasks.

original_quantity_total.description: WI-9: pre-split total quantity, kept for lineage.

quantity_done.description: WI-9: quantity already done. Defaults to 0.

quantity_total.description: WI-9: total quantity for a quantitative task (e.g. 30 題).

split_from_task_id.description: WI-9: for a remainder task, the id of the task it was split from.

Date.description:
A calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Serialized as a `"YYYY-MM-DD"` string for JSON and stored as `TEXT` in
SQLite. Wraps [`jiff::civil::Date`].

DeleteAllGcalResult.description: Result of explicitly deleting every mapped Google Calendar event.

DependencyAnalysisResponse.description:
Response for `GET /api/tasks/dependency-analysis` and the habit step
variant (#355).

DependencyNode.description: A node on a dependency witness path (task or habit step) (#355).

HabitDetail.description:
Habit detail response: the habit row plus its steps (#95). Used by
`GET /api/habits/:id` so clients receive steps in one round-trip.

window_mode.description:
Window mode for generated tasks (#window_mode).
`'day'` (default) = occurrence day's start_time..end_time.
`'period'` = occurrence start_time .. next occurrence's start_time.

apply.description:
When true, persist the computed `avg_minutes` / `sigma_minutes` to the
habit (and its steps). When false, return a preview only.

detect_outliers.description:
When true, detect and exclude outliers using the median absolute
deviation (MAD) before computing the estimate.

applied.description: True when the result was written back to the habit/steps.

habit.description: The updated habit row, present only when `apply` was true.

samples.description: Task-level samples for non-step habits. Empty for step-based habits.

HabitEstimateSample.description: One completed task observation included in a habit estimate.

HabitEstimateStep.description: Estimate result for a single habit step.

HabitPreviewRequest.description:
Preview request for `POST /api/habits/preview`. Mirrors `CreateHabit`
plus an optional step list and preview range.

HabitPreviewTask.description: A single task occurrence produced by `HabitPreviewRequest`.

window_mode.description:
Window mode for generated tasks (#window_mode).
`'day'` (default) = occurrence day's start_time..end_time.
`'period'` = occurrence start_time .. next occurrence's start_time.

HabitScheduledSpanRow.description:
A scheduled span for a habit (#503).

Its effect depends on `habits.active`:
- `active = true`: the span suppresses task generation (a pause).
- `active = false`: the span enables task generation (an activation window).

`start_date` / `end_date` are inclusive `YYYY-MM-DD` strings in the
user's local timezone.

HabitStepInput.description:
Input element for `PUT /api/habits/:id/steps` (bulk replace, #95).
An `id` present in the DB keeps the existing step (preserving its link to
generated tasks); an `id` absent or unknown creates a new step. Existing
steps not in the array are deleted. `depends_on` references step ids that
must exist in the resulting set.

HabitStepRow.description:
A step of a multi-step habit (#95). Each step produces one task per
occurrence with its own window / cost / flags. Steps form a DAG via
`depends_on` (JSON array of step ids within the same habit).

depends_on.description: JSON array of step ids this step depends on (within the same habit).

JsonString.description:
A wrapper that serializes `T` as a JSON string on the wire and in the DB.

Common instantiations:
- `JsonString<Vec<String>>` — task / step dependency lists
- `JsonString<Vec<ScheduleEntry>>` — schedule entry arrays

JsonString2.description:
A wrapper that serializes `T` as a JSON string on the wire and in the DB.

Common instantiations:
- `JsonString<Vec<String>>` — task / step dependency lists
- `JsonString<Vec<ScheduleEntry>>` — schedule entry arrays

MemorySource.description:
Provenance of a memory row (see `doc/code-quality-issues.md` §34).

Matches the `memories.source` CHECK constraint in
`migrations/016_memory.sql`: `user_confirmed`, `agent_inferred`,
`imported`. Currently only `UserConfirmed` is written by the storage
layer, but the schema accepts all three so the enum keeps them as
variants to round-trip existing rows safely.

event.description:
The recorded event, or `None` when the reported quantity_done has not
changed (no-op).

suggests_completion.description: True when the reported quantity_done reaches or exceeds the task total.

Quantity.description:
A non-negative integer quantity.

Negative values are rejected at construction time. The inner `i64` can be
retrieved via [`Quantity::get`].

RedundantDependency.description:
A redundant (composite / transitively implied) dependency edge with a
witness path proving the direct edge is unnecessary (#355).

ScheduleMode.description:
Reschedule / preview mode for schedule operations.

`Range` replans tasks within a time window; `Tasks` replans a specific
set of task IDs; `Full` regenerates the entire schedule (only valid for
preview — `reschedule` rejects it). Used by `Reschedule`,
`SchedulePreviewRequest`, and the CLI's `ScheduleCommands::Reschedule`.

comfortable_minutes.title: 459: 1 日の快適な作業時間（分）。`None` または `0` の場合はデフォルトを使う。

maximum_minutes.title: 459: 1 日の最大作業時間（分）。`None` または `0` の場合はデフォルトを使う。

seed.description: 乱数シード。`None` の場合は決定的なデフォルト。

solver.description: 使用する solver。`"sa"` / `"priority"` / `"auto"`。未設定の場合は `sa`。未知値はエラー。

time_budget_ms.description: 求解時間の上限（ミリ秒）。`None` または `0` の場合は制限なし。

warm_start.description: 前回スケジュールから priority/ALNS の初期解を warm start する。

Similarity.description:
A similarity score pairing a metric with a numeric value.

Serialized as `{"metric":"dice","score":0.85}`. Implements [`Default`]
(`Dice`, `0.0`) so it can be used with `#[sqlx(skip)]` / `#[serde(default)]`
on row structs where the SQL/JSON result does not include the field.

SimilarityMetric.description:
Similarity metric used by `Similarity` (see `doc/code-quality-issues.md` #33).

Kept in `takusu-types` so `takusu-contracts`, `takusu-client`, and
`takusu-worker` can all use it without changing the crate dependency
graph.

SleepInput.description:
Sleep configuration for schedule generation / reschedule / preview.

Parsed at the API/CLI boundary from a plain string; consumed by
`takusu-local-lib` to build a `SleepConfig` using settings + timezone.

Solver.description:
Phase 5 solver label (see `doc/type-safety-issues.md` §3.3).

Kept in `takusu-types` because `takusu-core` does not depend on `serde`,
and `takusu-contracts` / `takusu-client` / `takusu-worker` all depend on `takusu-types`.

end_at.description: Optional deadline for the remainder (defaults to the original end_at).

retained_quantity.description: Quantity to keep on the original task.

set_dependency.description: If true, make the remainder depend on the original task.

title.description: Optional title for the remainder (defaults to the original title).

actual_minutes.description: Total active work minutes from task_work_sessions (NULL when no work has been done).

completed_at.description: WI-9: wall-clock completion time, set by `complete`.

The habit step that generated this task, if any (#95). NULL for simple
(step-less) habits and manually created tasks.

quantity_done.description: WI-9: quantity already done. Defaults to 0.

quantity_total.description: WI-9: total quantity for a quantitative task (e.g. 30 題).

split_from_task_id.description: WI-9: for a remainder task, the id of the task it was split from.

TaskStatus.description:
Phase 1 type-safe labels (see `doc/type-safety-issues.md` §3.1 / 3.2 / 3.5 / 3.6).

These are intentionally kept in `takusu-types` so that `takusu-contracts`,
`takusu-client`, and `takusu-worker` can all use them without changing the
crate dependency graph.

TimeOfDay.description:
A time of day in `HH:MM` format with minutes snapped to 5-minute slots.

Serialized as a `"HH:MM"` string for JSON and stored as `TEXT` in SQLite.
This type was originally defined in `takusu-habit` and has been moved here
so that `takusu-contracts` / `takusu-client` / `takusu-worker` can use it
without depending on `takusu-habit`.

Timestamp.description:
An RFC 3339 timestamp.

Serialized as an RFC 3339 string for JSON and stored as `TEXT` in SQLite.
Wraps [`jiff::Timestamp`].
